query:
SELECT id, title, sageEnrichment IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(sageEnrichment) > 0 as is_enriched,
       LEFT(sageEnrichment, 50) as enrichment_preview
FROM achievements
WHERE clientId = 870001
ORDER BY id;
